relevant_laws.notes: Actual jurisdiction, marking, person, activity and exception remain source-gated.
relevant_laws.quote: No person shall stop, stand or park a vehicle except when necessary to avoid conflict with other traffic in compliance with law or the directions of a police officer or a traffic control device, in any of the following places: Within twenty feet of any marked crosswalk.
relevant_laws.relevance_type: vehicle stop, stand or park within twenty feet of marked crosswalk
